calm.$description: Backdrop for steady, upbeat and thinking moods

strained.$description: Backdrop for concerned and frustrated moods

away.$description: Backdrop while the member is away

position.$description: Keeps faces in frame in the 118px portrait

position-compact.$description: Keeps faces in frame in the shorter portrait of a short window (D101)

shadow.$description: Flat cards with a hairline, as on the canvas (D227)

shadow-selected.$description: The selected card: a 2px edge in the accent (its 1px border plus this ring), no glow (D227)

transition.$description: Hover lift, selection glow, picking dim

size.$description: The trust ring: 38px at 100% text, growing with the text size so its number stays inside (62px at 200%)

height.$description: Height of the three metric bars, kept while stats are hidden so cards line up
